data.name: April
data.gender_notes: April is used as a unisex name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The meaning of April is recorded in name-lists as “Opening month”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: April expresses “Opening month”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of April total 29, reducing to 2. Number 2 is associated with cooperation, sensitivity and balance.
